name: Wizard OS 0.3.100 — 0.3.99 with Agent Service 9cea1291 -> 1eaaa4f2 (fixes)
about: Latest 0.3.99 with Agent Service 9cea1291 -> 1eaaa4f2. Cut by the release train for merged Recommended fixes: humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#714 Recommended fix: Wizard ID approval shows the raw request when an event only partly matche; humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#732 Recommended fix: replies with pictures no longer show twice or as raw MEDIA text; humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#759 Recommended fix: keep the Resources Back control tappable; humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#766 Recommended fix: launcher tiles for agent Pages open in the Pages window; humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#769 Recommended fix: Replace Installed with Open after install; humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#770 Recommended fix: ignore gitleaks false positive on app-logo storage key; humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#772 Recommended fix: chat files download from the card; PDFs open in the viewer; humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#773 Recommended fix: chat file Download/viewer styles use tokens (style check); humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#284 Recommended fix: Import keeps host-shared paths on the host (main, conflict resolved); humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#285 Show routed agents' notes paths as their notebook, not [private attachment]. Stable stays 0.3.94 until the installed upgrade test passes.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.
